'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
